method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.description:
Predict the most likely nationalities of a person from their name.
Returns a ranked list of countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) with probability
scores and the count of people with that name in the underlying dataset.
Works best on last names. Accepts a single name or a list of up to 100
names per call.

name.description: A single name (full name or last) or a list of up to 100 names
